Confucius on humility

Confucius (551–479 BCE) approaches humility within Confucianism. He centered humane concern (ren), ritual propriety (li), moral example, and lifelong learning; rulers should govern by virtue rather than fear. Systematically, the teaching links ritual, ethics, education, government into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets humility most directly—useful for searches such as “confucius quotes on humility.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Confucius thinker page for biography and to the humility theme for other voices on the same question.
